title: 2. Core Components of the Arc
use_cases: Use when outlining a novel to ensure balanced pacing.
Use when teaching creative writing students the structure of a story.
Implement when drafting a screenplay beat sheet.
Use when editing a manuscript to ensure all arc stages are present.
Use when creating a content calendar for storytelling blog.
content:
| Component | Function | Typical Placement | Exposition | Introduces setting, characters, and initial situation. | Beginning | Rising Action | Builds tension, introduces conflict, develops stakes. | Middle | Climax | Highest point of conflict; decisive turning point. | Peak | Falling Action | Resolves immediate consequences, leads toward closure. | Late middle/early end | Resolution (Denouement) | Final outcome, ties loose ends, reflects on themes. | End |
